_doc: Registered capabilities that shipped without a caller. Being here means the gap is KNOWN and its completion is TRACKED — it does not fail the gate. Remove an entry when the capability is wired (utilisation rises above threshold) or when its tracking ADR closes. A NEW orphan not listed here fails the audit: wire it or register it with a reason.

knowledge.system.reason: settable in write_knowledge() but not exposed by the ingest API/CLI; inferred unreliably. Being promoted to an explicit, validated ingest param.

knowledge.valid_from (organic).reason: bitemporal fact-onset column shipped in OB2, wired to no settable source; defaults to now() on 100% of writes. Need is unmeasurable until exposed.

knowledge.valid_until.reason: written only by auto_supersede (always now()); never settable at ingest, never backdated. Real but narrow.

knowledge.supersedes_id.reason: supersession chain pointer; barely populated because auto_supersede is gated on a null-prone system. Superseded by the transition-record model.

knowledge.component_key(tag).reason: living-doc identity lives as an unvalidated freeform tag; being promoted to a validated column with a required system.
